cards.card_text: They follow one in the center of those who eat the flesh of swine, vermin and rats.
cards.verse_text: “Those who consecrate and purify themselves to enter the groves—to follow one in the center of those who eat the flesh of swine and vermin and rats—will perish together,” declares the LORD.
cards.snippet: …follow one in the center of those who eat the flesh of swine and vermin and rats—will perish together,” declares the LORD.

cards.card_text: Then Jesus drops a quick one, short and sharp: "Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine."
cards.verse_text: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine.
cards.snippet: …not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine.
